card.title: 866th RIFLES
card.text: Destruction: Add two BLASTS to your hand.
card.flavorText: The 866th Rifle Regiment was one of the original infantry regiments of the Soviet 287th Rifle Division, formed at Yelets in 1941. Its first campaign was brief and brutal. While still not fully ready for combat, the division was sent into the Bryansk Front reserve, then rushed by rail to Brasovo after German armor broke through Soviet lines. Between 3 and 5 October 1941, the 287th Division launched counterattacks near Bryansk, but the formation was trapped in the Bryansk pocket and almost completely destroyed by mid October. The regiment’s story did not end there. The 287th Rifle Division was rebuilt at Lipetsk in late 1941, from survivors who had escaped the pocket. With the same basic organization, including the 866th Rifle Regiment, it returned to the Bryansk Front and later fought under the 3rd, 63rd, 13th, 38th, and 3rd Guards Armies. By 1945, the division had fought into the Berlin Offensive and carried the honorific “Novograd Volynsky”, along with several other Soviet decorations.
